objective: Optimize the TSBS Fleet rollup by region benchmark hotspot while preserving the production_medium benchmark gate.
out_of_scope: benchmark harness behavior changes unless required for measurement

tasks.title: Optimize TSBS Fleet rollup by region
expected_changes: Inspect the TSBS rollup query and current GROUP BY aggregate fast path.
Reduce per-row work for `WHERE ts >= 1000 AND ts < 50000 GROUP BY region` without changing SQL semantics.
Add regression coverage for the optimized execution path.
Verify with focused SQL tests, release build, TSBS repeat benchmark, production repeat benchmark, and production benchmark gate.
acceptance: TSBS suite remains below the production_medium profile P95 threshold.
Production medium gate passes with the versioned profile.
All changes are limited to database core/query execution and workflow records.
